translations.about.meta.title: About us — BerryTrace
translations.about.meta.description: BerryTrace is a B2B supply service for Ukrainian IQF berries: we work with reliable verified producers and control quality, logistics and documents at every stage.
translations.about.title: We make buying Ukrainian IQF berries {$START_TAG_SPAN}transparent{$CLOSE_TAG_SPAN}
translations.about.lead: We work with reliable, verified Ukrainian producers of frozen berries and take responsibility ourselves for the quality, logistics and documents of every delivery. You deal with one BerryTrace team — and get a predictable delivery.
translations.about.do.title: One partner from the field to your warehouse
translations.about.do.producers.title: Reliable producers
translations.about.do.producers.text: We work only with verified producers: we control product quality, certification and the required documents.
translations.about.do.transparency.title: Transparency of every batch
translations.about.do.transparency.text: You know where the product comes from, what exactly you receive and where your batch is — at every stage.
translations.about.do.logistics.title: Logistics and documents
translations.about.do.logistics.text: We coordinate batch assembly, refrigerated transport, export documents and delivery.
translations.about.principles.title: What our work is built on
translations.about.principle1.title: Transparency
translations.about.principle1.text: We openly show where the product comes from and how the delivery goes.
translations.about.principle2.title: Quality
translations.about.principle2.text: We work only with producers who confirm quality with documents and lab tests.
translations.about.principle3.title: Responsibility
translations.about.principle3.text: We are accountable to the customer for the result of the delivery and find solutions when something goes off plan.
translations.about.principle4.title: Simplicity
translations.about.principle4.text: Minimum bureaucracy: request, offer and delivery — in one place.
translations.about.final.title: Have a question or ready for your first order?
translations.about.final.text: Write to us — we will reply and help you choose berries for your request.
translations.audience.title: Who we serve
translations.audience.lead: We help businesses worldwide source high-quality IQF berries from Ukraine — consistently, transparently and hassle-free.
translations.audience.statText: We work with a wide range of market players — from international traders to finished-goods manufacturers and HoReCa venues.
translations.audience.cardText1: We ensure stable deliveries and full supply chain transparency.
translations.audience.cardText2: Reliable raw materials for juices, smoothies and other beverages.
translations.audience.cardText3: IQF berries for confectionery, bakery and other food applications.
translations.audience.cardText4: We help you find verified suppliers for your own brands.
translations.audience.cardText5: We supply quality IQF berries to restaurants, hotels and catering companies.
translations.audit.brief.title: Audit brief
translations.audit.brief.requirementsValue: Take 3 samples from the raspberry batch, check the temperature logs for the last month, video of the cold room.
translations.audit.step1.title: Choose a producer
translations.audit.step1.text: From the platform catalog, or name your own supplier you want to check.
translations.audit.step2.title: Write the audit brief
translations.audit.step2.text: Describe what the auditor must do: which areas, documents, processes and batches to check, and by when.
translations.audit.step3.title: The auditor visits the site
translations.audit.step3.text: An independent auditor inspects the site strictly according to your brief, with photo and video evidence.
translations.audit.step4.title: Get the report in your account
translations.audit.step4.text: A report with findings for every item of the brief appears in your account on the platform.
translations.audit.report.point1: A finding for every item of your brief: compliant, remark or non-compliant
translations.audit.report.point2: Photos and videos from the site, linked to specific items
translations.audit.report.point3: Copies of documents and laboratory test results
translations.audit.report.point4: The auditor's overall conclusion and recommendations
translations.audit.report.point5: All reports stay in your account — download them as PDF and share with your team

translations.audit.meta.description: Independent audits of IQF berry producers against your brief: capacity, cold chain, documents, traceability, sampling. The report arrives in your account on the platform.

translations.audit.title: Check a producer against your own brief
translations.audit.lead: Order an independent audit of an IQF berry producer: describe exactly what the auditor should check — and get a detailed report in your account on the platform.
translations.audit.how.title: From brief to report — four steps
translations.audit.include.title: You decide exactly what the auditor checks
translations.audit.include.lead: Pick ready-made items or describe your own requirements — the auditor works strictly to your brief.
translations.audit.include.capacity.text: Actual production capacity, freezing volumes and stock available in the warehouse.
translations.audit.include.cold.text: Blast freezing, storage temperature, temperature logs and the condition of cold rooms.
translations.audit.include.docs.text: Presence and validity of certificates, permits, declarations and internal quality procedures.
translations.audit.include.trace.text: Labelling, records and the link between a specific batch and its field, harvest and freezing dates.
translations.audit.include.lab.text: Samples taken from your batch and sent to a laboratory for the parameters you specify.
translations.audit.include.media.title: Photo and video report
translations.audit.include.media.text: Footage of production halls, the warehouse, packing and the specific batch — with date.
translations.audit.report.title: The result — in your account on the platform
translations.audit.final.title: Want to check a producer before you buy?
translations.audit.final.text: Write a brief — we'll find an auditor and let you know the timing and cost.
translations.cta.title: Buying IQF berries from Ukraine has never been this easy
translations.cta.lead: Find verified producers, choose the products you need and manage deliveries in one place. Sign up for free and get access to the BerryTrace catalog.
translations.customs.meta.title: Customs and logistics — BerryTrace
translations.customs.meta.description: Refrigerated delivery of IQF berries, export documents and customs clearance — from the producer to your warehouse. One team all the way.
translations.customs.title: Customs and logistics — {$START_TAG_SPAN}turnkey{$CLOSE_TAG_SPAN}
translations.customs.lead: We take care of refrigerated delivery, export documents and customs clearance so your batch gets from the producer to your warehouse on time and without extra worry.
translations.customs.include.title: Everything a delivery needs — in one place
translations.customs.transport.title: Refrigerated transport
translations.customs.transport.text: We select the carrier and monitor the temperature throughout the entire route.
translations.customs.documents.title: Export documents
translations.customs.documents.text: We prepare the full set of documents for the batch, including quality and origin certificates.
translations.customs.clearance.title: Customs clearance
translations.customs.clearance.text: We support clearance at the border and prepare customs documents in advance.
translations.customs.lab.title: Batch analyses
translations.customs.lab.text: We arrange sampling and lab analyses for the parameters you specify.
translations.customs.tracking.title: Batch status
translations.customs.tracking.text: We tell you where your batch is, from loading to arrival.
translations.customs.manager.title: Single point of contact
translations.customs.manager.text: One manager for all delivery questions — from the plant to your warehouse.
translations.customs.steps.title: From loading to your warehouse — four stages
translations.customs.step1.title: We assemble the batch
translations.customs.step1.text: We agree the volume, packaging and readiness dates with the producer.
translations.customs.step2.title: We prepare documents
translations.customs.step2.text: We collect certificates and draw up export documents.
translations.customs.step3.title: We ship and clear
translations.customs.step3.text: We organise refrigerated shipping and customs clearance.
translations.customs.step4.title: We deliver to your warehouse
translations.customs.step4.text: The batch arrives with the full set of documents.
translations.customs.final.title: Need delivery for your batch?
translations.customs.final.text: Describe your request — we will suggest the route and timing.

translations.geography.noteText: Ukraine is one of Europe's leading berry producers, with unique climate conditions and high product quality.

translations.privacy.title: Privacy policy
translations.privacy.lead: We explain what data we collect on the BerryTrace website, why we need it and how you can manage it.
translations.privacy.s1.title: 1. What data we collect
translations.privacy.s1.p1: We collect only the data needed to run the website and to contact you:
translations.privacy.s1.i1: your email address and the site language if you subscribe to notifications about the platform launch;
translations.privacy.s1.i2: data you give us yourself via WhatsApp or email, including your name, company and request details;
translations.privacy.s1.i3: technical data and, with your consent, analytics and marketing data collected by cookies.
translations.privacy.s2.title: 2. Why we use data
translations.privacy.s2.i1: notify you about the launch of online ordering;
translations.privacy.s2.i2: reply to your request and prepare a commercial offer;
translations.privacy.s2.i3: improve the website and the service if you agreed to analytics cookies.
translations.privacy.s3.title: 3. Cookies
translations.privacy.s3.p1: Necessary cookies keep the website working and do not require consent. We turn on analytics and marketing cookies only after you agree. You can change your choice at any time via “Cookie settings” at the bottom of the page. We store it in your browser.
translations.privacy.s4.title: 4. Sharing data with third parties
translations.privacy.s4.p1: We do not sell your data. It may be processed by services that help us operate (email notifications, analytics, hosting) only to the extent needed for those purposes.
translations.privacy.s5.title: 5. Retention
translations.privacy.s5.p1: We keep data no longer than needed for the purposes it was collected for. You can unsubscribe from notifications or ask us to delete your data at any time.
translations.privacy.s6.title: 6. Your rights
translations.privacy.s6.p1: You can ask what data we hold about you, correct or delete it, restrict processing and withdraw consent. These rights apply under Ukrainian law and, where applicable, the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
translations.privacy.s7.title: 7. Contact
translations.privacy.s7.p1: For questions about personal data, write to sales@berrytrace.com.
translations.privacy.meta.title: Privacy policy — BerryTrace
translations.privacy.meta.description: What data BerryTrace collects, why it uses it, how long it keeps it and what rights users have.
translations.process.title: From request to {$START_TAG_SPAN}your delivery{$CLOSE_TAG_SPAN}
translations.process.lead: We take care of finding and vetting producers, assembling the batch and organizing logistics. You choose the products you need, and we guide the process until you receive the goods.
translations.process.noteText: Transparent, with a full document package and quality control.
translations.process.cardPara1: Choose IQF berries in the catalog, create a request and specify your product requirements and certificates.
translations.process.cardPara2: We clarify the details and prepare a commercial offer tailored to your needs.
translations.process.cardPara3: We select reliable suppliers and check product quality, certification and required documents.
translations.process.cardPara4: If needed, we arrange an independent production audit and laboratory testing.
translations.process.cardPara5: We agree on volumes, packaging and lead times.
translations.process.cardPara6: If needed, we consolidate products from several producers into one truck, optimizing loading and transport costs.
translations.process.cardPara7: We coordinate loading, refrigerated transport and export documentation.
translations.process.cardPara8: You track the delivery status and access all documents in one place.
translations.process.cardPara9: IQF berries arrive at your warehouse on the agreed schedule.
translations.process.cardPara10: You receive a full set of shipping documents and a transparent history of every batch — from producer to delivery.
translations.siteFooter.tagline: A B2B platform for buying Ukrainian IQF berries with traceability for every batch.
translations.terms.title: Public offer
translations.terms.lead: General terms of using the BerryTrace website and how we work with customers.
translations.terms.s1.title: 1. General provisions
translations.terms.s1.p1: This document sets out the terms of using the BerryTrace website and how BerryTrace and customers work together. By using the website or sending us a request, you agree to these terms.
translations.terms.s2.title: 2. The platform and website information
translations.terms.s2.p1: Online ordering on the platform is under development. Information on the website is for reference and is not a final offer for a specific batch, price or delivery date.
translations.terms.s3.title: 3. Ordering
translations.terms.s3.p1: An order is placed as follows:
translations.terms.s3.i1: you send a request with your product requirements and certificates;
translations.terms.s3.i2: we prepare a commercial offer with volume, price and timing;
translations.terms.s3.i3: delivery terms are fixed in a separate contract or specification agreed by the parties.
translations.terms.s4.title: 4. Prices and payment
translations.terms.s4.p1: Prices, currency and payment terms are set individually in the commercial offer and contract.
translations.terms.s5.title: 5. Delivery, quality and documents
translations.terms.s5.p1: Delivery, acceptance, product quality and accompanying documents are governed by the contract. We coordinate logistics and documents and keep you informed about the batch status at every stage.
translations.terms.s6.title: 6. Liability
translations.terms.s6.p1: The parties are liable under the law and the contract. We make every effort to keep website information accurate but do not guarantee that it is free of errors or outdated data.
translations.terms.s7.title: 7. Personal data
translations.terms.s7.p1: The processing of personal data is described in the Privacy policy.
translations.terms.s8.title: 8. Contact
translations.terms.s8.p1: For questions about this offer, write to sales@berrytrace.com.
translations.terms.meta.title: Public offer — BerryTrace
translations.terms.meta.description: BerryTrace public offer: general terms of using the website and how we work with customers.
translations.testimonials.title: What our partners say
translations.testimonials.lead: In the words of people who regularly buy berries through BerryTrace.
translations.testimonials.quote1: I regularly order frozen berries and grits here. What I like most is that everything is fast and high quality, with no surprises. I write, get a reply, we agree — and off we go.
translations.testimonials.quote2: We have worked with the BerryTrace team from day one and are still happy. This is exactly the case where the partnership rests not only on a contract, but on genuine human trust.
translations.testimonials.quote3: We've bought more than one truckload from them. Things happen — sometimes customs delays, sometimes delays with lab analyses. But there hasn't been a single situation we couldn't solve together.
translations.trust.title: You know{$LINE_BREAK}who you buy from,{$LINE_BREAK}what you get{$LINE_BREAK}{$START_TAG_SPAN}and where your batch is{$CLOSE_TAG_SPAN}
translations.trust.lead: We minimize the risks of international IQF berry procurement. We vet producers, control quality and ensure transparency at every stage of delivery.
translations.trust.cardText1: We work with Ukrainian producers and check documents, production capacity and compliance with your requirements. If needed, we arrange an independent audit.
translations.trust.cardText2: Review of specifications, certificates and lab results. If needed — additional batch testing before shipment.
translations.trust.cardText3: From product origin to delivery status — key information and shipping documents in one place. You always know where your berries come from and what stage they are at.
translations.trust.cardText4: We coordinate batch assembly, refrigerated transport, export documents and delivery. One contact for all delivery questions — from the plant to your warehouse.
